title: CRASH-091: htmlentities get next char multibyte peek reads past string oob (heap-buffer-overflow)
live_proof: measured, not asserted: our native ASan build of the pinned 5.0.0 tarball (p12, gcc 15.2.0, libasan from gcc 15, 2026-10-27) reports ASAN:heap-buffer-overflow at ext/standard/html.c:656 in get_next_char when trigger.php runs; the corpus records the fix as php-src 9d1986647629, which postdates the release, and names the defect at ext/standard/html.c:656 (str[pos+1] unchecked; the enabling signature defect is at html.c:486-490)
fidelity: the corpus's own trigger script, run through the real interpreter (PHP's cli SAPI, ext/standard only, the port's 145 translation units) rather than reduced to a C model. What it does NOT establish is which arm ought to catch it. The pristine build completes it natively, so an arm that completes it saw nothing.
fault_sites_why: ASan's access stack in our native run (results-ours-asan-default.json, sha256 045e3366bfc5) has get_next_char at ext/standard/html.c:656 as its first frame inside PHP's tree (frame #0); the stack's remaining frames are the interpreter's dispatch and are not sites
